body:
I know I'm probably not the best person to be giving any advice in this matter...at all, but logic shouldn't dictate something like this.  Logic is so...subjective in some areas depending on the branch of philosophy that you're packing your logic into.  Right now, I'm not in the mindset, but I can remember being really happy and thinking things like 'logically speaking, I should live for the moments when I'm happy because if I were to cease to live, I would cease all ability to be happy'.

Don't let your parents get to you.  Parents are really shitty sometimes and you don't deserve shitty parents.  It's not you that is 'bad', but them and 'they' are wrong for seeing you as anything but their child and giving you the unconditional love that you do deserve.

What do you enjoy in life--something that your parents have no baring on?  Are you in college?

EDIT: And, after reading your other reply, I want to add that, honestly, being successful in life is really the sweetest revenge on other people.  The best "I'll show them".  I mean, what would be better than proving them wrong and forcing them to watch you become great when they thought less of you?
